name: Tool — Azure AI Search
summary: AzureAISearchTool against a customer-owned search index, attached to a BYOM-routed agent.
description: Index-side embeddings are configured at index-build time outside this matrix. Skips if AZURE_AI_SEARCH_CONNECTION_ID or AZURE_AI_SEARCH_INDEX_NAME is unset.
notes: Needs to be re-verified end-to-end against a BYOM-routed agent. Not in the official supported-tools list.
